title: Efficient Doubly Adaptive Biased Coin Designs for Multiple Treatments
summary: The randomness, efficiency (power and variability), and desirable allocation proportions are important components for evaluating a response-adaptive design in clinical trials and conflicted demands in applications. The aim of this paper is to provide designs dealing with these dilemmas. We first give a general framework for efficient response-adaptive randomization procedures that attain the Cramér-Rao lower bounds of the allocation variances for any desired allocation proportions.
